# Principia Robotica — Complete Architectural & Mathematical Context

> Real-time Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) safety filter and Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway for autonomous mobile robotics. Dual implementation in zero-allocation C++17 (`cpp/`) and dependency-free Python (`principia/`).

## 1. Mathematical Foundation
Large Language Models generating velocity inputs lack inherent dynamical safety guarantees. Principia Robotica enforces continuous-time forward invariance $h(x) \ge 0$ of the safe set $\mathcal{C} = \{x \in \mathbb{R}^n : h(x) \ge 0\}$ under unicycle kinematic assumptions via Nagumo's Theorem:

$$u^*(x) = \arg\min_{u \in \mathcal{U}} \frac{1}{2}\|u - u_{\text{nom}}\|_Q^2 \quad \text{s.t.} \quad L_f h(x) + L_g h(x)u \ge -\gamma h(x)$$

- Median Closed-Form Latency: **31.5 µs** (>20,000 Hz throughput on single-core x86_64).
- Automated Verification: **68/68 Python tests** + **C++17 ASan/UBSan test suite**.
